title: Navy officer portrait in dress blues on BUPERS photograph submission form, 22 March 1960
description: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of a U.S. Navy officer in dark service dress uniform with ribbons, seated before an American flag, attached over a form titled 'Instructions for Submission of Photograph in Accordance with Article B-2210 BuPers Manual'. Typed fields below give the officer's rank as CWO-4, corps 'CHPHOT', and 'Date Photograph was taken: 22 MARCH 1960'. The sheet is annotated 'BUPERS / FILE JACKET'.
